metadata.title: Your apps | Boardsesh for developers
metadata.description: Register an app that reads a climber's Boardsesh logbook once they approve it.

page.title: Your apps
page.lead: Register an app so climbers can connect it to their Boardsesh logbook. Nothing is shared until a climber approves your app on the consent screen.
page.limits: Up to {{apps}} apps per account. Each new app can connect {{connections}} climbers, and {{perDay}} new climbers a day.

empty.title: No apps yet
empty.body: Register an app to get a client ID. An app whose server exchanges the code also gets a client secret.

notAvailable.title: App registration isn't open yet
notAvailable.body: Boardsesh hasn't switched on partner apps. Check back later.

notAllowlisted.title: App registration is invite-only for now
notAllowlisted.body: Your account isn't on the invite list. Ask the Boardsesh team for access.

paused.title: App registration is paused
paused.body: Boardsesh paused partner apps for a moment. Try again in a minute.

failed.title: Your apps didn't load
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.

app.noPublisher: No publisher set. Edit the app to add one; until then the consent screen shows no "Made by" line.

auth.CLIENT_SECRET_BASIC: Confidential: secret in an HTTP Basic header
auth.CLIENT_SECRET_POST: Confidential: secret in the form body

app.newPerDay: Up to {{count}} new climbers a day

suspended.title: Suspended by Boardsesh
suspended.body: This app gets no tokens and can't be changed or deleted. Reason: {{reason}}
suspended.noReason: This app gets no tokens and can't be changed or deleted.

form.name: App name
form.nameHelp: Climbers see this on the consent screen. 3 to 50 characters.
form.publisherHelp: The person or company that makes the app. Climbers see "Made by" with this name.
form.urlHelp: Starts with https://. Linked from the consent screen.
form.applicationType: Where the sign-in comes back to
form.applicationTypeNative: A mobile, desktop or command-line app
form.applicationTypeNativeHelp: Also allows http://127.0.0.1 or http://[::1] on any port, and a custom scheme such as com.example.app:/oauth/boardsesh.
form.clientType: Where the code is exchanged for tokens
form.clientTypeConfidentialHelp: You get a client secret. Keep it on the server only.
form.clientTypePublic: On the device or in the browser
form.clientTypePublicHelp: No secret. PKCE protects the code. Use this for anything you ship to users.
form.secretMethod: How your server sends the secret
form.redirectUrisHelp: One per line, up to 10. Matched exactly, except the port of a loopback address.

secret.createdWarning: Copy the client secret now. Boardsesh won't show it again.
secret.rotatedWarning: The old secret has stopped working. Copy the new one now: Boardsesh won't show it again.
secret.lostHelp: Lost it later? Make a new secret from the app's card. The old one stops working at once.
secret.publicNote: This is a public app, so there is no secret. Send a PKCE code challenge with every authorization.
secret.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.

rotate.title: Make a new secret for {{app}}?
rotate.body: The current secret stops working the moment you confirm. Token requests from your server fail until you deploy the new one.

delete.title: Delete {{app}}?
delete.connected_one: {{count}} climber is connected. Deleting the app disconnects them at once, and their tokens stop working.
delete.connected_other: {{count}} climbers are connected. Deleting the app disconnects all of them at once, and their tokens stop working.
delete.noneConnected: No climbers are connected. Any sign-in in progress for this app stops working.

errors.busy: Boardsesh is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.rateLimited: Too many changes in a minute. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.gone: This app no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
errors.suspended: Boardsesh suspended this app, so it can't be changed.
errors.emailNotVerified: Verify your email address before you register an app.
